notes: The two `אֶת־פְּנֵי` phrases are read as one fused unit each under rule 30, headed on the construct noun, rather than as an unrepresented marker beside a noun holding the whole English word — the outcome rule 30 expressly forbids. MACULA's gloss *with* points to H854, but the fusion holds on either reading of the lemma.
`בַּשָּׁנָה` gives the indefinite *a* to the noun under rule 15 and leaves the assimilated article `unrepresented`, since the ASV writes no *the* for the phrase.
